subject.title: [Bug]: Heartbeat / async system events can interrupt and effectively swallow in-progress replies in Telegram topic sessions

question: What should the permanent heartbeat/system-event policy be for active Telegram topic sessions when a user-visible reply is running or final delivery is still settling?
rationale: Current main proves useful partial guards, but the remaining reports cross compatibility-sensitive heartbeat isolation, immediate/manual wake semantics, restart recovery, and Telegram delivery routing.

options.title: Define non-preemptive active-session policy
options.body: Require heartbeat/system-event work to defer or isolate around active user-visible sessions, then validate Telegram topic, restart, and stale-replay paths before closing this issue.

options.title: Keep only narrow active-run guards
options.body: Treat the shipped active-run and pending-final guards as sufficient for this issue, and move any later default-target or stale-replay reports to narrower canonical issues.

options.title: Fold into broader contamination tracker
options.body: Route remaining work to the broader heartbeat contamination issue and keep this report linked as Telegram-specific evidence.

recommendation.title: Define non-preemptive active-session policy
recommendation.body: Require heartbeat/system-event work to defer or isolate around active user-visible sessions, then validate Telegram topic, restart, and stale-replay paths before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history places this person closest to the heartbeat runner guard and pending-final recovery surface that now needs policy calibration.
